summary: Implemented U5 and U13: docs/orchestrator-task-map.md gained a new 'Pricing a task's node work' section with the exact node_work/cap formula and numeric defaults, pointing to `group --price`. skills/orchestrator-plan/SKILL.md now states the U<N>/u<N>-slug id convention, requires a Summary: line per unit, marks symbols as optional with the measured dense-codebase degeneration trade-off replacing the old unconditional instruction, requires one Verification bullet per checkable item, adds Summary: to the unit template, and inserts a `group --advise` step into Phase 7 hand-off (after --no-spec, before the summary/dry-run) that presents diagnostics and asks the user to choose split-vs-proceed-as-one, explicitly deferring the mechanical split/deepen command as not-yet-existing wave-2 work. Changes committed as c2a5200.

verification_results.notes: docs/orchestrator-task-map.md states node_work = source_bytes/4.0 × 1.3 + per-file allowance, cap = 200,000 − head, names all multipliers, and points at group --price

SKILL.md Phase 2 replaces the unconditional symbols instruction with the dense-codebase trade-off; Units section states Summary: requirement and Verification-bullet convention; template shows Summary: field
Phase 7 runs --advise after --no-spec, instructs presenting diagnostics, and phrases the choice as a question with proceed-as-one as an explicit option
No auto-split/regenerate instruction added; the single 'deepen command' mention only states it doesn't exist yet, not that it's runnable
